Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved cookies very much. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a new cookie to eat. Timmy thought that was funny and asked his mom to brush her milk. 

Timmy's mom took the cookie, but Timmy ate it all up. He was sad because he loved playing with his toys all day long. But then, his mom came in and said, "Timmy, you need to wear your special cookie. It's very popular." Timmy didn't want to keep it, so he kept it a good way to get it.
